newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates surge amid market operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates surge amid market operation.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates soared on Wednesday amid an open market operatrion by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan and dealers said shortage of funds was likely to keep the rates at higher levels.
The overnight rates traded in the range of 17 and 19 percent throughout the day owing to shortage of funds, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.

The central bank picked up an estimated one billion rupees at a cut-off yield of 15.80 percent a year against an inflow of about 700 million rupees on maturity of paper sold in an earlier open market operation, he said.
He said banks dicounted about 2.5 billion rupees with the central bank because of heavy outflows from the banking system.
